prompt: Without looking at any images, describe the most iconic image of Laughing Nailong (大笑奶龙 / 奶蛙) from memory: its pose, expression, body shape, colors, rendering style, and background, in enough detail for an artist who has never seen it to draw it. Say where you are unsure.
answer:
I remember Laughing Nailong as a plump golden-yellow baby dragon caught mid-belly laugh. Draw him almost front-on, with his short legs planted apart, his round belly pushed forward, and his oversized head tipped back a little. His tiny arms lift away from his sides. I’m less sure of the exact hand positions.

The mouth is the focal point. Make it a broad, rounded opening that takes up much of the lower face, with a dark reddish interior and a pink tongue low inside. Squeeze the eyes into narrow laughing crescents above the raised cheeks. Give him a short, rounded snout, a head that blends into the body with very little neck, stubby limbs, and a belly that’s a paler buttery yellow than the rest of him.

Render him like a soft 3D cartoon toy, with smooth surfaces, rounded edges, and gentle highlights on the forehead, cheeks, and belly. I remember the figure more clearly than the background. I’d use plain white or off-white for a sticker-like drawing. I’m also unsure whether teeth or the tail are visible in the familiar crop.
